description: IRVE SYDESL 71 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by FREDERIC ADE. Strategic deployment plan for public charging stations for electric vehicles to be deployed (2026-2035) Locations of charging stations for electric vehicles in Saône-et-Loire (excluding the Grand-Chalon agglomeration), resulting from the Master Plan for Charging Infrastructure for Electric Vehicles drawn up in 2024. Coverage: FREDERIC ADE. The publisher named on the listing is FREDERIC ADE. Its keywords include sdirve, irve-stations-de-recharge, fichier-irve-des-bornes-de-recharge, irve, fichier-irve-de-bornes-de-recharge. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
